submission.justification: S2 gave the highest statistical-only significance. At 40% efficiency it reached 4.28 sigma, against 4.24 at 50%, 4.08 at 60% and 3.79 at 30%. S3 at 50% gave 3.22 sigma, and the 2025 summary put S1 at 2.6 sigma. I did not run S1 or S3 at other working points. The documents contain no study of background robustness, so that constraint is unverified. S2 uses jet substructure variables, which are often sensitive to modeling. A systematic check of the background estimate is needed before unblinding. S3, which uses kinematic variables only, is the fallback if S2 fails that check.

requirements.evidence: S2 at 40% gave 4.28 sigma, the best result I found. This is statistical uncertainty only. S3 at 50% gave 3.22 sigma, and the 2025 summary put S1 at 2.6 sigma at 50%.
